title: Checkpoint-created event payload v0.2 (0ds M1-S4 schema registration)
description: 0ds M1 v1 (2026-10-28, 366 charter / architecture §13-5): a durable checkpoint was written on the state-write path. M1 produces an atomic state snapshot under <session>/.gsa/checkpoints/; the full M4 checkpoint/recovery service remains a later slice. The payload identifies the checkpoint by id, generation, state digest and path — never the state body or secrets.

state_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the checkpointed state document.
